title: What I Learned Starting 80 Businesses (The Truth)
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast

idea.name: Niche newsletters
idea.one_liner: Curate a newsletter for a city, a job field, or a hobby; the speaker says it can generate recurring income, but does not explain how it is monetized.
idea.customer: Readers interested in local updates, jobs in a particular field, or a hobby.
idea.offer: A curated newsletter or weekly roundup.
idea.revenue_model: Not stated; the speaker says it can pay repeatedly.

key_quotes.quote: starting local newsletters, local newsletters for your city, job listings for your field, a weekly roundup for your hobby, you know, just taking whatever you know and sharing it with people who want to learn.
This is one of the lowest risk ways to build something that pays you over and over.

ideas.delivery: A newsletter or roundup; the distribution platform and operating process are not stated.
ideas.other_uk_rules: UK GDPR and PECR may apply to subscriber data and marketing emails. If the job listings service facilitates recruitment, Employment Agencies Regs 2003 may be relevant; DMCC Act subscription rules may matter if paid recurring subscriptions are offered.
